name: One-Pan Honey-Mustard Pork Chops

cookwares.name: large carbon steel or cast iron skillet

ingredients.name: bone-in pork rib chops, about 1 to 1 1/2 inches thick
thyme leaves, plus more for garnish

instructions.primary_message: Mince the shallot. Pick the thyme leaves from the stems and mince them. Juice the lemon.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small shallot
1 tbsp thyme leaves, plus more for garnish
½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Pat pork chops dry with a paper towel. In a small bowl, combine salt and baking soda. Season pork chops generously on all sides with salt mixture. (You may have some seasoning mixture left over; reserve for another use or discard.) Transfer to a wire rack set in a rimmed 13- by 46-cm baking sheet. If dry-brining chops overnight, refrigerate, uncovered, at least 8 hours and up to 24; otherwise proceed immediately to step 2.

Preheat oven to 121°C (250°F). Season chops with pepper. Place baking sheet with pork chops in oven and cook until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of the chops registers 100 to 43°C (38 to 43°C) for medium-rare, 20 to 25 minutes, or 110 to 49°C (43 to 49°C) for medium, 35 to 40 minutes. To prevent overcooking, start checking temperature 5 to 10 minutes before suggested time. Remove from oven.

Heat oil in a large carbon steel or cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking. Working in batches if necessary to not overcrowd the skillet, place pork chops in skillet and cook, turning occasionally, until browned and an instant-read thermometer registers 120 to 130° (49 to 54°C) for medium-rare or 130 to 60°C (54 to 60°C) for medium, about 3 to 5 minutes. Stack pork chops with tongs, hold them on their sides, and sear the fat caps on the edges until crisp, about 1 minute. Remove pan from heat, transfer chops to a clean rack set in a rimmed baking sheet, and let rest for 3 to 5 minutes while you prepare the sauce.

Pour fat from skillet; do not wipe out pan. Add 1 tablespoon butter and melt over medium-high heat. Add shallots and thyme and cook, stirring, until softened, about 1 minute. Stir in white wine or broth and bring to a simmer. Lower heat to medium and simmer until liquid is slightly reduced, about 4 minutes. Stir in mustard, honey, lemon juice, and remaining 3 tablespoons butter until well combined. Remove from heat, season to taste, and serve chops with sauce spooned on top.

schema_metadata.keywords: honey mustard pork chops, pork chops, pork chop recipe

description: These juicy, tender honey-mustard pork chops are incredibly easy to make., require minimal prep, and can be on the table in less than 45 minutes. Plus: It comes together in a single skillet.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 9 hr.

Optional substitutions: white wine → low-sodium chicken broth

Notes: This recipe can be prepared with boneless pork loin chops, but boneless pork chops won’t be as flavorful as bone-in. They will likely take less time to cook; to prevent overcooking, start checking temperature 5 to 10 minutes before suggested time for bone-in pork chops.

Make-ahead and storage: Leftover pork chops and sauce can be refrigerated separately in airtight containers for up to 3 days. The pork chops can be reheated in the microwave or in a 175°C (350°F) oven or air fryer until warmed through. The sauce can be gently reheated in the microwave on low power.
author: Genevieve Yam
